newsitem.title: USA: Lexington Corporate to sell preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: Lexington Corporate to sell preferred shrs.

text.p: Lexington Corporate Properties Inc said on Thursday it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell up to two million shares of its preferred stock to an investment fund managed by Rothschild Realty Inc, raising about $25 million.
Under the agreement, Lexington may sell the preferred stock to Five Arrows Realty Securities LLC at up to three closings during the next 12 months.
The issuance of all two million shares would represent about 16.7 percent of Lexington's outstanding equity, it said.

Lexington said it expects to sell about 700,000 shares at a closing in January, and use the proceeds to repay about $8.5 million of mortgage debt secured by four properties net-leased to Toys R Us Inc.

"This capital commitment from Five Arrows will allow Lexington to continue to implement its growth-oriented business plan, while lowering our debt to total capitalization ratio," Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Robert Roskind said in a statement.
Lexington is a self-managed real estate investment trust.
